title: Gluing a chosen family of local wedge morphisms
statement: A chosen family of local wedge morphisms satisfying the prescribed formula glues to a global morphism satisfying that formula.

lean.statement: theorem determinant_wedgeMorphism_glue_family {X : Scheme.{v}} (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃) [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁] (φU : ∀ U : X.Opens, exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃ ⟶ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂) (hformula : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U)) (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)), (∀ i, S.g.val.app (op U) (c i) = b i) → (φU U).val.app (op U) (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a) (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ U b)) = exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ U (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))) : ∃ φ : exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃ ⟶ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂, ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U)) (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)), (∀ i, S.g.val.app (op U) (c i) = b i) → φ.val.app (op U) (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a) (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ U b)) = exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ U (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))
